analysis.narrative:

· 스윙 저항선 ($1,944.16) — 5일 고가($1,937.17) 상회 시 돌파 시도 가능성
· 5일 고가/저가($1,937.17/$1,847.17), 20일 고가/저가($1,976.46/$1,821.49) — 횡보 패턴 확인
[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) — 거래량 부재 및 지표 중립으로 관망 유지 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($1,920.77) vs SMA5 ($1,902.2)/SMA20 ($1,896.08)/SMA50 ($1,798.52) — Short-to-mid term trend above, long-term trend position diagnosed.
· Above SMA100 ($1,906.4), below SMA200 ($2,055.44) — Potential shift to weaker long-term trend.
· 52-week position (12.0%) — Attempting rebound from historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (50.2 → 57.2) — Neutral range sustained, sideways movement after exiting oversold.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-10.1752 → -2.3412) — Improvement confirmed, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $1,896.08) — Bandwidth narrowed to 6.09%, lack of directional momentum.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1,915.3) — Support zone based on Pivot Point (PP $1,906.24).
· Swing Resistance ($1,944.16) — Potential for breakout attempt if 5-day high ($1,937.17) is surpassed.
· 5-day High/Low ($1,937.17/$1,847.17), 20-day High/Low ($1,976.46/$1,821.49) — Sideways pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.45x) — Below 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current Range Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — Maintaining wait-and-see due to lack of volume and neutral indicators.
